text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Taking a brilliant 1st place is Narita Brian!
Following the Satsuki Sho, she has achieved the Double Crown!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaaaah----!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian thrusts her fist into the air!
This year's Derby Umamusume responds to the cheers!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(When I close my eyes, I see that battle along the final stretch.
Fighting tooth and nail for a finish line neither would yield.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(I still can't shake the sensation of running.
More, I need more—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —I want to win!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Brian! Brian!!
Brian!! Brian......――

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I have returned.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. But the next Kikuka Sho is won by
the 'strongest Umamusume,' right?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is a 3,000-meter turf race.
Said to be won by the one who possesses both speed and stamina, it is the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The battle for the goal is still ongoing.
An even more thrilling race is...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san! Congratulations
on achieving the Double Crown!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is hoping for the birth of a Triple Crown Umamusume
to follow in Symboli Rudolf-san's footsteps!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A Triple Crown Umamusume "second" to Rudolf, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Absurd.
Who's 'second to' anyone?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If you're aiming for something, you aim to 'surpass' it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after the live concert finished,
I escorted Narita Brian back to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ama-san?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You took the Japanese Derby,
...and I took the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ho... So you have claimed two tiaras.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Preparations to come for your neck
are almost complete.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So? When are we fighting?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't get ahead of yourself.
The stage for settling this is the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Why don't we settle who's superior right then and there?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What if neither wins the Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter to me. Rich coming from someone
who had zero interest in titles from the start.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I want to discuss
the path after the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is the grand showdown held at the end of the year.
A 2,500m turf race at Nakayama, where top-class Umamusume contest in both name and reality.
choice_data_list: So you'll be racing against senior Uma Musume too, huh.
So you'll be racing against senior Uma Musume too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho decides the strongest of a generation,
while the Arima Kinen decides the strongest across generations, I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hah... That's the spirit.
Always striving for greater heights—
that is the true essence of an Umamusume...!
